document_id: Cavaleri 2019 - The October 29, 2018 storm in Northern Italy – An exceptional event and its modeling

impacts.description: High waves on the Ligurian Sea and the Northern Adriatic Sea

evidence.quote: The winds led to high waves both on the Ligurian Sea and the Northern Adriatic Sea.

impacts.description: Crest heights of up to +9 m and surge of +1.30 m recorded on the ISMAR oceanographic tower

evidence.quote: Both data and minor damage on the horizontal outgoing platform (deck 2) provide evidence of up to +9 m crest heights (but with +1.30 m surge).

impacts.description: Extensive forest damage with an estimated loss of 11 million trees in the Dolomites and Eastern Alps

evidence.quote: very extensive forest damage (estimated loss of 11 million trees).
